chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from Ibn Sinan, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
“For the Imam, one takbir suffices him; and three suffice you, recited deliberately, when you are alone.”

key_terms.تَكْبِيرَةٌ: a takbir; the utterance of 'Allahu Akbar'

ai.seo_question: How many takbirs are sufficient in salat for the Imam and for someone praying alone?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a ruling regarding the number of takbirs in salat under different circumstances. It distinguishes between the Imam and one praying alone, indicating that a single takbir suffices for the Imam, while three measured takbirs suffice for the individual praying alone.
